scientific_integrity: The proof supplies explicit rational Sylvester certificates and an elementary logistic-map argument. The literature comparison has residual risk of older equivalent formulations. The 2026-05-18 date is a publicly listed conference presentation of the method; the complete preprint was submitted 2026-07-14.
scientific_limitations: Exact symmetric positive-definite square-root data and an exact frozen Sylvester solver. Commuting theorem is all finite dimensions, but noncommuting cone exit is a strict 2 by 2 witness. Local attraction is not global convergence; example is outside small-error conditions for a particular low-precision initializer. No floating-point or general noncommuting failure theorem.
title: Commutative positivity and noncommutative cone escape in frozen-Sylvester square-root refinement
